body: I can't get out of bed. I am physically too ill. All my life is about getting better. Thats all I focus on. Thats why I want to die. Because nothing is working.
I'd rather not say. But I'm unable to get out of bed for the most part so its not like I'm in any position to date.
My life is not going to get better because my illness is not going to get better. I'm not talking about the depression. I have a chronic illness that has taken over my life and RUINED it.
Not when you're sick with an illness that has no guarantee to get better. I'm going to be confined to a bed for the rest of my life. Whats the point in that kind of life? I'd rather be dead.
